georeference.note: Corners of the illustrated grounds map, traced against three features the illustration and the real world share: I-35 down the east edge (lon -93.7800), County Road G50 across the bottom right (lat 41.29340) and N Cross St / Walnut Trail on the west (lon -93.8055). The artwork is an illustration, not a survey, so treat pin positions as approximate — a hundred metres or so out in places.
